privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: Words of Praise ("we", "us") is a daily Bible reading app. This policy explains what data we collect, why we collect it, and how you can control it. We keep it plain — no legalese.

collect.heading: What we collect
collect.account: when you sign up with email: your email address and a hashed password. When you sign up with Google: your name and email from Google. We never see your Google password.
collect.content: journal entries, verse favorites, community board posts, prayer requests, and verse annotations. This content is stored on our servers and is only visible to you (journals, favorites, annotations) or to all users (community posts, prayer wall).
collect.activity: to power the app's features and show your progress, we store things like your reading streak, Blessings balance and milestones, reading-plan progress, Manna puzzle results, and daily discipline completions. This data is tied to your account and is only visible to you.
collect.usage: page views, feature interactions, and session data collected via PostHog analytics. This helps us understand how the app is used so we can improve it. We identify logged-in users by a numeric ID, never by name or email.
collect.errors: if the app crashes or throws an error, Sentry automatically captures a stack trace, your browser/OS version, and the page you were on. No personally identifiable information is included in error reports.
collect.email: if you subscribe to the daily verse newsletter from the landing page, we store your email to send you the daily verse. You can unsubscribe at any time via the link in every email.
collect.payment: if you purchase a Premium lifetime license, payment is processed entirely by Stripe. We never see or store your card number. We store only your Stripe customer ID and subscription status.
collect.push: if you opt in to push notifications, we store your browser's push subscription token to deliver daily verse reminders. We do not use this for marketing.
collect.security: our servers process your IP address to apply rate limits and protect against abuse (for example, blocking brute-force login attempts). IP addresses are used transiently for security and may appear in short-lived server logs; we do not use them to build a profile of you or sell them.

use.heading: How we use it
items: Deliver the daily verse, reading plans, and app features to you
Send the daily verse email to newsletter subscribers
Send streak-break reminder emails (if you opt in to reminders)
Understand how features are used so we can improve them
Protect accounts and prevent abuse (rate limiting and security)
use.footer: We do not sell your data. We do not use your data for advertising.

thirdParty.heading: Third-party services
thirdParty.intro: Words of Praise uses the following third-party services. Each has its own privacy policy:

retention.heading: Data retention
retention.p1: Your account data is kept for as long as your account exists. If you delete your account, your personal data, journal entries, favorites, and annotations are permanently deleted within 30 days. Community posts and prayer wall entries may remain anonymised.
retention.p2: Newsletter subscribers who unsubscribe have their email removed immediately.

rights.heading: Your rights
items: Access or export your data — email us and we'll send it within 30 days
Delete your account and all associated data from the Settings page
Unsubscribe from emails at any time via the unsubscribe link
Opt out of push notifications in your browser settings at any time
rights.footer: If you are in the EU or California, you have additional rights under GDPR and CCPA respectively. Contact us to exercise them.

cookies.heading: Cookies & local storage
cookies.p1: We do not use advertising cookies. We use browser local storage to save your preferences (theme, language, font size, sound settings) locally on your device. This data never leaves your device.
cookies.p2: PostHog sets a first-party cookie to distinguish sessions. No cross-site tracking cookies are used.

children.heading: Children
children.body: Words of Praise is not directed at children under 13. We do not knowingly collect data from children under 13. If you believe a child has provided us with personal data, contact us and we will delete it.

changes.heading: Changes to this policy
changes.body: If we make material changes, we will update the "Last updated" date above. Continued use of the app after changes take effect constitutes acceptance of the updated policy.

about.missionText: Words of Praise is a daily spiritual companion — a place to encounter God's Word, cultivate faithfulness, and connect with a community of believers. Every feature is built with one purpose: to make your daily practice feel seen, honored, and worth returning to.
about.subtitle: Your Daily Companion in God's Word

about.feature2Desc: Write personal journal entries and attach reflections to any verse. Your thoughts, preserved.
about.feature3Desc: A daily biblical word puzzle — find the hidden word of the day, drawn from Scripture.
about.feature4Desc: Track your streak, earn Blessings, and reach milestones that honor your consistency in the Word.
about.feature5Desc: Share reflections, read what others are praying, and feel the presence of a global community.
about.feature6Desc: Free public-domain translations included. Premium unlocks NIV, ESV, NLT, and more.
about.feature7Desc: Personalize your experience with beautiful themes. Earn or purchase premium looks and add-ons.
about.feature8Desc: Full support for English, Español, Français, and Kreyòl Ayisyen.
about.feature9Desc: Multi-day Scripture journeys with verse text, guided prayer, a daily action, and a reflection prompt — all in one place.

about.faqSubtitle: Quick answers to the most common questions.

faq.a1: Your streak counts the number of consecutive days you've opened the daily verse. If you miss a day without using a Grace Day, your streak resets to zero. To protect your streak after a missed day, tap "Use a Grace Day" — you get 2 Grace Days per month that refill automatically on the 1st.
faq.a2: Grace Days let you retroactively count a missed day as read, so your streak stays intact. You receive 2 Grace Days each calendar month. They do not carry over — unused Grace Days expire at the end of the month. You can also purchase a Grace Day Pack (3 extra days for $0.99) in the Shop.
faq.q3: Why am I not receiving push notifications?
faq.a3: Browser push is supported on Chrome for Android and Safari on iPhone. Make sure you've allowed notifications when prompted — if you accidentally denied them, go to your browser settings and re-enable them for this site. Email reminders are available to all users regardless of browser as an alternative.
faq.q4: Why can I only make 4 guesses in Manna?
faq.a4: Free accounts are limited to 4 guesses per Manna puzzle. A premium membership increases this to 6 guesses and also unlocks the full scripture clue from the start, hints (which reveal a letter for 15 Blessings), and detailed solve statistics.
faq.q5: How do I unlock modern translations like NIV or ESV?
faq.a5: Modern translations (NIV, ESV, NLT, and more) are premium. You can unlock them with a Premium membership ($9.99 once, no subscription) or a one-time "Modern Translations" purchase for $3.99 in the Shop.
faq.q6: What are Blessings and what can I do with them?
faq.a6: Blessings (✦) are the app's in-app currency, earned by reading the daily verse, writing reflections, journaling, playing Manna, and reaching streak milestones. Premium members earn 1.5× Blessings on every action. Spend them in the Shop to unlock themes. They never expire.
faq.a7: Reading Plans are multi-day Scripture journeys with a verse or passage, guided prayer, a daily action step, a reflection prompt, and a comprehension quiz for each day. Browse the Plans library to find one that fits where you are spiritually — free to explore for everyone. Creating a free account lets you enroll and track your day-by-day progress.
faq.q8: Can I use Words of Praise without creating an account?
faq.a8: Yes — the daily verse, Manna puzzle, and Reading Plans library are available without signing up. Creating a free account unlocks your streak, journal, favorites, prayer wall, and progress saved across all your devices.
faq.q9: A page isn't loading or something looks broken — what should I do?
faq.a9: Start with a refresh — this fixes most issues. On desktop press Ctrl + R (Cmd + R on Mac); on mobile, pull down on the page to reload or close and reopen the tab. For persistent problems, try a hard refresh (Ctrl + Shift + R on desktop) or clear your browser's cache and site data in browser settings. If a specific feature keeps failing, email us and we'll look into it.
faq.q10: The daily verse still shows yesterday's — why hasn't it changed?
faq.a10: The verse resets at midnight UTC-10 (Hawaii time), which may be later than your local midnight. If that time has passed and it still hasn't changed, try refreshing the page. On mobile, pull down on the verse card to force a reload.
faq.q11: I was logged out unexpectedly — is that normal?
faq.a11: Sessions expire after a long period of inactivity for security. Just sign back in — your streak, favorites, journal, and progress are all saved to your account. If this happens frequently, check that your browser isn't set to clear cookies when it closes.
faq.q12: I paid for premium but features are still locked — what happened?
faq.a12: After completing checkout, reload the app to sync your account. If features are still locked after a full page reload, sign out and sign back in. Still missing? Email us with your payment email address and we'll verify the transaction manually.
faq.q13: The app feels slow or is freezing on my phone
faq.a13: Try closing and reopening the browser tab. Clearing your browser cache (Safari: Settings → Safari → Clear History; Chrome: Settings → Privacy → Clear Browsing Data) often resolves persistent slowness. On iPhone, enabling Reduce Motion in Accessibility settings can also help with animation-heavy pages.

gamificationTutorial.title: Streaks & Blessings
gamificationTutorial.subtitle: Stay consistent, earn rewards, and grow in faith every day.
gamificationTutorial.step1Body: Read the daily verse every day to grow your streak. The longer the streak, the more Blessings ✦ you earn per day.
gamificationTutorial.step2Body: Blessings are earned by reading daily, completing Manna puzzles, and hitting milestones. Spend them on hints or themes in the Shop.
gamificationTutorial.step3Body: Reach streak milestones (7, 30, 100 days and beyond) to unlock celebration moments and bonus Blessings rewards.
gamificationTutorial.step4Body: View your streak history, longest streak, and total Blessings balance on your Profile page.
gamificationTutorial.reopenHint: Find this in Settings → Help & Tutorials anytime.

shopTutorial.title: Rewards Shop
shopTutorial.subtitle: Spend Blessings, unlock themes, and upgrade your experience.
shopTutorial.step1Body: Your Blessings ✦ balance is shown at the top of this page. Everything in the shop is purchased with Blessings or a Premium subscription.
shopTutorial.step2Body: Purchase beautiful app themes with Blessings to personalize your experience. Premium members unlock all themes.
shopTutorial.step3Body: Premium unlocks unlimited journal entries, all translations, saved searches, a Blessings multiplier, and more.
shopTutorial.step4Body: Some features are available as permanent one-time unlocks — no subscription needed.
